findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 2 in the same format as Chapter 1 (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 32 questions numbered 1-32; by section: 2.2 2, 2.3 4, 2.4 6, 2.6 6, 2.7 4, 2.8 2, 2.9 2, 2.10 2, 2.11 2, 2.12 2.

16 pairs (theory 5 marks + numerical 3 marks) covering rectangular components, scalar and vector products, the three equations of motion (both methods), projectile motion, momentum and impulse, conservation of momentum, elastic and inelastic collisions in one and two dimensions, and rocket propulsion. Numericals use new values, recomputed in Python. Book corrections followed: phi from Eq. (2.40) divided by Eq. (2.39); the rocket equation is given without the clashing number (2.42).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
